جدول ARP (روترها و سوییچ‌های لایه ۳) و ج: ARP tables (routers and layer-3 switches) and switch MAC tables are read with SNMP; nothing is changed on the devices. The devices are the monitoring SNMP targets. A port where the MAC was seen that has only a few MACs (and no LLDP/CDP neighbor in the “Map”) is the most likely location. On Cisco, each VLAN's MAC table is read separately (community@VLAN, or context vlan-N with SNMPv3).
